# ANCH1 results — generated by `mktables.py`, do not hand-edit

In-sample variants evaluated (no significance claimed): **348**.
Out-of-sample confirmations, each run once: **24**.
Luck bar √(2·ln 24) = **2.521**.

## 4. Naked POC: the revisit claim, tested

The practitioner claim is that ~80% of naked POCs are revisited within 10 sessions. True — but so is almost any price in the same range, which is what makes it not a POC property.

| symbol | naked POCs live per day | real revisit rate | random price in same range | gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MES | 13.9 | 0.9100 (n=500) | 0.8954 (n=5000) | **+1.46 pp** |
| MNQ | 10.8 | 0.9180 (n=500) | 0.8906 (n=5000) | **+2.74 pp** |
| MGC | 12.3 | 0.9202 (n=501) | 0.8988 (n=5010) | **+2.14 pp** |
| MCL | 5.9 | 0.9089 (n=483) | 0.8917 (n=4830) | **+1.72 pp** |

Pre-registered threshold was +5.00 pp. The largest gap measured is +2.74 pp.

## 5. Merged timeframes: why F4 is unmeasurable, not null

A confluent LVN needs an LVN on ≥2 of the 1-session / 1-week / 1-month / 3-month 60m profiles within ¼ ATR. That is rare enough that the arm never reaches the 20-trade floor.

| symbol | confluent LVNs per day | single-window LVNs per day | IS trades, confluent break |
|---|---|---|---|
| MES | 0.22 | 2.43 | 12 |
| MNQ | 0.23 | 2.55 | 13 |
| MGC | 0.35 | 2.90 | 6 |
| MCL | 0.48 | 2.40 | 2 |
